own: This will come down to how serious the change is that they're doing, if they even have the ability been granted to them to make those types of changes. And if so, they can avoid causing the changes that they've made to not take hold for 24 hours by having a more secure login method. And let's actually clarify that. So when the 24-hour hold comes on, it's really just going to be a hold on the changes that you're implementing. Those are what's going to be on hold. Everything else will still function as normal. So that might be different than how we had planned it before, but that makes the most sense, that just whatever changes you put in play are put on hold for 24 hours if you have the weakest security method.
question: Can a team member's username-and-password login put the whole team account on a 24-hour hold?
